text: Okay I finally got all my gadgets and want a map of them. The Hub is in the center, big and indigo. The Lamp, Lock, Cam and Speaker each talk to the Hub, so connect the Hub to all four of them with plain lines. Then arrange the four around in a circle. Hmm, that fights with the center thing, never mind, leave them where they are and move the Cam to the top. Is the Lock directly connected to the Speaker? I don't think so. Make the Speaker a hexagon and the Lamp yellow. Anything else near the Cam? Finally I'd like the Hub at the back, behind the lines.
Pixel art start. Make the Dot tiny and put it at the bottom. Make the Dot a red circle. Is the Dot red now? Move the Dot 20 pixels to the left.

Road network for my urban planning class, three streets and a lot of confusion. Is the Main road bigger than Side? Make the Main a huge gray rectangle. Side should be a small gray rectangle. Link the Main to the Side. Put the Main at the center. Put the Side at the top. Is the Side connected to the Main? Which one is the leftmost? How many connections are there? Is the Side near the Main? Rename the Side to Alley. Thanks!

I'm designing our support escalation flow. The Ticket first goes to the Bot. If the Bot can't solve it, it goes to the Agent, and if the Agent can't, it goes to the Manager. Connect those in a chain please, in that order. The Bot should be a cyan square, the Agent a circle, and the Manager a star because stars are special. Place the Manager at the far right, and the Ticket on the far left. Can I get to the Manager from the Ticket? Show me all the paths. Hmm, just say whether it's possible. And which node has the most links? I bet it's the Agent.
Variable names. rename A to Alpha, no, to Apex. Make A a big red circle. Is A red? Put A at the center.
Party decor. Move the Balloon above the Cake. Make the Balloon a red circle. The Cake should be a big white square. Is the Balloon above the Cake?

Bookshelf. Nudge Book1 to the left, no wait, to the right by 30. Make Book1 red, Book2 green and Book3 blue. Link Book1, Book2 and Book3 in a chain. Is Book3 reachable from Book1?

Rail yard map for the model railway club, I am renovating the layout. The Station and the Depot are linked, right? Make the Station a big gold rectangle. The Depot should be a huge gray rectangle. Link the Station to the Depot with a dashed line. Put the Station at the left. Put the Depot at the right. Is the Station near the Depot? Which one is the biggest? How many rectangles are there? Count the connections. Rename the Depot to Shed. Is the Station reachable from the Depot? Thanks, the club meets on Friday.
Ad banner mockup. I need three of those Banners. Duplicate it 2 times. Make the Banner a big yellow rectangle. How many rectangles do we have now? Put the Banner at the top.

Food truck menu. Is the Pizza gold? Is the Burger brown? Is the Taco green?

Hi there, I'm the night nurse and this is how I picture the building. It has six units. Er, Icu and Ward are the patient areas. Lab, Pharmacy and Clinic are the support areas. Make the patient areas red and the support areas blue. Er goes at the top, Icu in the middle and Ward at the bottom. Hmm I changed my mind, left to right is easier to read: Er on the left, Icu in the middle, Ward on the right. Then the support shapes go underneath in a row. Link Er to Icu and Icu to Ward. Is there any route from Er to Ward? Which unit has the most connections? And are there any green shapes? I guess not. Thank you!

Is the Ram connected to the Cpu? Which one is the leftmost? Put the Ram at the bottom. Is the Cpu bigger than the Ram? Count the connections. What is the degree of the Cpu? Rename the Ram to Memory.
